slices.focus: Birthday painting project sparks Latin pop commute reset
slices.summary: Around her birthday, Lucia and Daniel spend a weekend painting a patched hallway with a restored 1990s Latin pop playlist playing. The music becomes an unexpectedly powerful transition tool — she starts reaching for it on the drive home after rough hearing days instead of defaulting to talk radio, noticing it leaves her less wound up and more present with Daniel. The conversation explores how the playlist works as a 'gentler off-ramp' from work mode, and Lucia decides to create two versions (one for ordinary tired, one for truly scorched days). She plans to keep the core anchor songs tied to that birthday weekend and tell Daniel the playlist 'helps me arrive home more like myself.'
